name: Yugo Metals Ltd
summary: Headquartered in Perth, Australia, and incorporated in 2021, Yugo Metals Limited (formerly Lykos Metals Limited, a name adopted in June 2025) is engaged in the exploration and development of mineral properties across Bosnia and Herzegovina. The company's efforts are directed towards discovering a wide spectrum of valuable deposits, encompassing nickel, cobalt, gold, silver, antimony, copper, zinc, lead, iron, barite, and other significant base and precious metals. Its operational footprint includes 100% ownership of three distinct projects: the Sinjakovo project, which consolidates the Sinjakovo and Jezero tenements over approximately 80.8 square kilometers; the Sockovac project, covering about 29 square kilometers; and the Cajnice project, extending across roughly 49.5 square kilometers.
